title: Point SMARTCITY_V1_PLATFORM_BASE at the app's own primary domain instead of the auto-generated DigitalOcean hostname
act: state-changing, production: PUT /v2/apps/95691c40-27ca-4afb-b9b4-a37e079c5e69 spec, exactly one leaf changed
triggerHonoured: The row said DO NOT DISPATCH UNTIL G-166 IS GREEN. G-166 landed, and smartcity-dashboards main was verified green (a11y success, test success) on 0848dd72 before the change was made. The trigger is satisfied, not assumed.

readBack.verifiedBy: fetching the app spec again after the deployment and reading the entry by field

acceptance.clause1: the four A-187 feeds render the same `status` and `basis` after the change as before it, read from the deployed surface's own composition rather than from the app spec

clause1Evidence.readFrom: GET https://app.smartcityos.io/api/domains/<domain>?cityKey=bastrop_tx with the G-135 lane-verification identity in x-hauska-key

fire-apparatus.basis: Apparatus data exists in FirstDue but current API credentials do not have access (contact dashboards@firstarriving.com to request apparatus/assets API scope).

fleet-vehicles.basis: cachedFetch('vehicles', '/fleet/vehicles') + stats batch (engineStates,obdOdometerMeters,obdEngineSeconds,fuelPercents), 60s TTL, + fetchDvirs()/fetchSafetyEvents() (30-day/7-day windows, 5-min TTL)

clause1Evidence.after: identical for all four, status and basis strings unchanged
clause1Evidence.note: fleet-vehicles reads 72 in BOTH readings because the G-172 fix was already deployed earlier in the same session; the base change did not move it.

acceptance.clause2: a request from the integration seat can open a connection to the configured base, which it cannot do today

retiredBase.result: curl exit 28, no connection, from this seat

instrumentRepairedInTheSameAct.problem: it pinned TARGET_BASE to the masked auto-generated hostname, so this change would have made it report a false FAIL on the next run
instrumentRepairedInTheSameAct.fix: TARGET_BASE is now https://smartcityos.io, with a retained negative guard against the masked name and a new one against any a.run.app host

newInstrument.purpose: the generic forced redeploy + guarded single-env write that program.md rule 12 and OPS-17 A-170/A-149 name but no file provided; dolphin-ship.mjs could not be used because its one allowed diff is an env entry that is already written
guards: refuses if the app already serves the target commit (no --set-env)
finds the created deployment by SET DIFFERENCE; a 2xx that creates none is a failure
reads services[0].source_commit_hash BACK BY FIELD and compares it byte for byte against GitHub's branch head, so two independent sources must agree
for --set-env: refuses to add a key, refuses to rewrite a SECRET, and enumerates every leaf difference in the spec tree so nothing outside the one named entry can be written
newInstrument.selfTest: 7 cases, both directions, run before any network or credential access: identical, stale by one commit, same prefix, null, undefined, empty, and an empty target. 7/7 PASS.

leaveBehind.why: this row scopes the change to the dolphin-app spec env only, so the UAT twin was deliberately not touched
leaveBehind.consequence: the UAT app still reads the masked host server-side (which works), but no external lane can read that host to verify it
leaveBehind.planRow: not carded - named here so it is a decision rather than an omission
